title: More than just real estate, it’s real life experience 🤍
description:
From leaving corporate America to becoming a trusted resource for military families, Reganne brings heart, honesty, and real-life understanding into every transaction.

She knows the military lifestyle because she lives it every single day. The challenges, the pivots, the unexpected moments, all of it shaped the way she serves her clients with empathy, strategy, and care.

And if you’ve called 15 times for the lockbox code… just know it probably could’ve been an email 😂

At the end of the day, success for Reganne isn’t just about closing deals, it’s about building relationships clients trust enough to keep coming back to.

#EliteRealtyProfessionals #ReganneQueen #MilitarySpouseRealtor #TexasRealEstate #MilitaryRelocation
